invariants.rationale: The method assumes 'config' is a non-null input in all code paths.
The method always returns a non-null Option (never returns null).
If 'config.populateMetaFields()' is true, an empty Option is returned; otherwise, Option.of(...) is returned.
Equivalent relational expression for symmetry, showing the relationship between config and the result Option's presence.
Only if Option is present, its value is cast to BaseKeyGenerator, safe given method code.
